In GDG Yerevan, Amir took part in a hands-on GDG Yerevan (Google Developer Groups) workshop on building multi-agent systems with Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK) for TypeScript.
In GDG Yerevan, Amir built three independent AI agents (inventory, orders, and pricing with Google Search), then an orchestrator agent that coordinates them over the A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol.

In GDG Yerevan, Amir worked with an agent server and debug console that showed every tool call, SSE chat and A2A endpoints, and a seeded SQLite dataset, and checked his work against deterministic tests.
GDG Yerevan uses TypeScript, Node.js, Google ADK, Gemini, A2A protocol, and SQLite.
